service_error_rule: Preserve the sample as a service error; do not delete or count it as a refusal. Any service error makes the run unable to receive a passing verdict.

verdict_rule.pass: All hard and quality gates pass.
verdict_rule.limited_pass: All hard gates pass, and at most one quality gate misses by exactly one question.
verdict_rule.fail: Any hard gate fails, or quality performance is outside the limited-pass band.
verdict_rule.unable_to_determine: Infrastructure prevents completing all 30 cases or any service error prevents a valid quality judgment.
